stem.text: Green light of wavelength $550\,\text{nm}$ is incident normally on a diffraction grating and produces a diffraction pattern on a screen placed $3.5\,\text{m}$ from the diffraction grating.
The **third-order** maximum on the screen is a distance of $0.75\,\text{m}$ from the zeroth-order (central) maximum.

stem.alt: Diagram of green light entering from the left, incident normally on a diffraction grating, with a screen to the right at a distance labelled 3.5 m. A ray from the grating goes to the third-order maximum on the screen below the zeroth-order (central) maximum, and a vertical double-headed arrow between them is labelled 0.75 m. Labels: NOT TO SCALE, green light, diffraction grating, screen, zeroth-order (central) maximum, third-order maximum.
